body:
Two of her most devastating breakup tracks, one impossible call — "Dear John" vs "All Too Well (10 Minute Version)". No fence-sitting: commit to one and defend it in the replies. Every era's heartbreak song lives in Blank Spaces →

altText: Taylor Swift performing the folklore set of the Eras Tour in Inglewood, 2023, on a moss-covered cottage stage set.
why: X sibling of the 09-19 Blank Spaces hero quiz-poll (see the IG item's why for the Dear John / All Too Well (10 Minute Version) sourcing from relationships.mjs). Written first as its own post: one idea (pick one of the two songs, defend it), the link. Deliberately near-disjoint vocabulary from the IG body outside the two shared song titles and the thread name, to clear the <80% cross-post-copy coefficient (the smaller X body is what makes that coefficient spike, so it drops the IG's shared words — pick/both/wrecked/scarf/stadium/short film/tag). Hook: the challenge, structurally unlike the IG post. Media: selector-preferred credited Taylor photo in an era unused this fortnight (folklore), a different era from the IG speak-now tile and no era twice inside a 4-day span; X site-screens prohibited; photoEra unset (post spans eras, thread:love-story not a themed prefix). Weighted length under 270 (autolinked URL counts 23). Thread post = share-hook exempt. First five words diverge from the IG sibling and from 09-17's love-story X. Lyric-free. rulesChecked [].

critique.rationale: A one-breath X version of the Blank Spaces poll — the two named songs, a real 'pick one and defend it' challenge, structurally unlike its IG sibling and under the weighted length cap. The credited folklore tour tile is on-brand but not the songs' own era, so it earns its place loosely.
